source: GameFAQs (section 'PlayStation PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)')
author: EmoneyWains
what_it_is: This is the perfect starter save with only 5 CTR tokens and 8 relics left to collect. You begin a new game with 17% completion, you'll be at zero relics but I've tested the save so it will increase as you win relic races. Enjoy :)

gamefaqs.section: PlayStation PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: zip of 1 PS3 export(s) (.PSV): '\0VSP' header (signature, save name at 0x64), the save's blocks from 0x84 (8324 bytes); it holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASCUS-94426-SLOTS)
